experiences.description:
- Processed and entered over 200 customer records daily into the company database while maintaining a high level of data accuracy.

- Verified and validated customer information in accordance with company standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
- Organized, maintained, and systematically archived administrative documents to support efficient document retrieval and record management.
- Conducted preliminary interviews with prospective customers to collect, verify, and ensure the completeness of customer information.

- Provided personalized customer service and product recommendations for gaming peripherals, including keyboards, mice, headsets, and speakers, to support customers in selecting products that matched their needs.
- Assisted customers throughout the PC-building process, from hardware specification consultations and component assembly to performance testing and maintenance.
- Conducted monthly physical inventory counts (stock opname) to verify stock availability and maintain inventory accuracy.
- Performed cleaning, routine maintenance, and basic servicing of PCs, laptops, and keyboards to help maintain device performance and cleanliness.
- Utilized Accurate accounting software to manage incoming and outgoing inventory, generate sales reports, monitor stock levels, and process purchase requests.
- Used ClickUp to document, track, and monitor daily store operations, supporting task coordination and operational accountability.
